snippet.textDisplay: I have read the NCAA Football Rule Book (several times) and there is not a SINGLE RULE that says "If multiple plays are reviewed the replay OFFICIAL MUST rule so that each team gets the same number of replay calls going for them".  Did most of the reviewed plays end up going for TEXAS?  Yes they did but that does not mean the ruling by replay was WRONG or BAD.  It happens.  The diving "catch" was ruled no catch because yo can see the ball moving.  The TD review was the same, ball moving.  The Arch Pass/Fumble I think COULD have gone either way, however the White Hat (ref) called a fumble and there was not enough to change that call.  And the play at the end of the half was a clear fumble and recovery by TEXAS but was not changed.  That play probably cost Texas points at the end of the half.  Maybe the actual job the officials did was overall bad (there were so many uncalled fouls on both teams) but the plays that were reviewed were correct.
